# Verifies the current-directory scope option in a monorepo: file flags and
# line stats are limited to the target directory, the branch component stays
# repository-wide, and a locally clean directory is distinguished from a
# fully clean repository.

# Build gitmux.
cd $GITMUX_DIR
exec go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

# Create a repository with two subdirectories, including tracked files with
# special paths.
exec git init -q repo
cd repo
exec git config user.email tester@email.com
exec git config user.name TesteurDeTest
mkdir a
mkdir b
exec sh -c 'printf "a1\n" > a/a1.txt; printf "a2\n" > a/a2.txt; printf "w\n" > "a/w [1].txt"; printf "d\n" > a/-dash.txt; printf "c\n" > "a/中文.txt"; printf "b1\n" > b/b1.txt; printf "b2\n" > b/b2.txt'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -qm base
exec git branch -m main

# Outputs are compared after appending a newline (the golden section files
# carry a trailing newline).
# 1) Whole repository clean, status from a/.
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out1
cmp $WORK/out1 $WORK/golden1

# 2) Change only in b/: from a/, the directory is locally clean but the
#    repository isn't -> local-clean indicator, no file counts, no stats.
exec sh -c 'printf "x\n" >> b/b1.txt'
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out2
cmp $WORK/out2 $WORK/golden2

# 3) Scope disabled (default): same situation reports the change in b/.
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg2.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out3
cmp $WORK/out3 $WORK/golden3

# 4) Change in both directories: from a/, only the local one is counted.
exec sh -c 'printf "y\n" >> a/a1.txt'
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out4
cmp $WORK/out4 $WORK/golden4

# 5) Staged rename crossing INTO the scope (b/b1.txt -> a/b1.txt) counts once.
exec git reset -q --hard HEAD
exec git mv b/b1.txt a/b1.txt
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out5
cmp $WORK/out5 $WORK/golden5

# 6) Staged rename crossing OUT OF the scope (a/a1.txt -> moved.txt) counts once.
exec git reset -q --hard HEAD
exec git mv a/a1.txt moved.txt
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out6
cmp $WORK/out6 $WORK/golden6

# 7) Special paths: modifications of tracked files with spaces, brackets, a
#    leading dash and unicode, plus collapsed untracked directories.
exec git reset -q --hard HEAD
exec sh -c 'printf "x\n" >> "a/w [1].txt"; printf "x\n" >> a/-dash.txt; printf "x\n" >> "a/中文.txt"'
exec sh -c 'printf "u\n" > "a/new [u].txt"; mkdir -p a/u_dir; printf "u2\n" > a/u_dir/u2.txt'
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo/a
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out7
cmp $WORK/out7 $WORK/golden7

# 8) From the repository root, the scope covers the whole tree.
exec git reset -q --hard HEAD
exec git clean -fdq
exec sh -c 'printf "x\n" >> b/b1.txt'
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out8
cmp $WORK/out8 $WORK/golden8

# 9) Repository root, clean tree.
exec git reset -q --hard HEAD
exec $WORK/gitmux --cfg $WORK/cfg.yml $WORK/repo
stdin stdout
exec sed 's/$/\n/'
cp stdout $WORK/out9
cmp $WORK/out9 $WORK/golden9

-- cfg.yml --
tmux:
  symbols: {branch: "B", clean: "C", clean_local: "L", staged: "S", conflict: "X", modified: "M", untracked: "U", stashed: "T", insertions: "+", deletions: "-"}
  styles: {clear: "", state: "", branch: "", remote: "", divergence: "", staged: "", conflict: "", modified: "", untracked: "", stashed: "", clean: "", clean_local: "", insertions: "", deletions: ""}
  layout: [branch, flags, stats]
  options: {current_dir_scope: true}

-- cfg2.yml --
tmux:
  symbols: {branch: "B", clean: "C", clean_local: "L", staged: "S", conflict: "X", modified: "M", untracked: "U", stashed: "T", insertions: "+", deletions: "-"}
  styles: {clear: "", state: "", branch: "", remote: "", divergence: "", staged: "", conflict: "", modified: "", untracked: "", stashed: "", clean: "", clean_local: "", insertions: "", deletions: ""}
  layout: [branch, flags, stats]
  options: {current_dir_scope: false}

-- golden1 --
Bmain C#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden2 --
Bmain L#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden3 --
Bmain M1 +1#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden4 --
Bmain M1 +1#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden5 --
Bmain S1#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden6 --
Bmain S1#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden7 --
Bmain M3 U2 +3#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden8 --
Bmain M1 +1#[fg=default,bg=default]
-- golden9 --
Bmain C#[fg=default,bg=default]
